The '''Corellian Dreadnaughts''' were a [[Smashball/Legends|smashball]] team from [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. Their nemeses were the [[Ranphyxes]] and the [[Infuriated Savages]]. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] was a fan of them.
